purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0161 in the gauge arena: the field-borne string at the point the coupled Sigma(648) rule reaches under the modified action (beta0 7.4, deconfined): the field alone charges a static love-fear pair 19.3, 16.6, 30.8 per slice at R = 1 to 3, not monotonic, its slope times beta (3.56) is some 300 times the empty field chi(2,2) (0.012), and a meson is held by the field but barely moves (travel 2.45), so every physics gate fails.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
